## Notes

- Cell value = anti-armour damage points inflicted on the target hex's armour; absorbed by armour protection ratings per SPI 14.4
- Rows are the sequential two-dice reading (SPI 11.4) in pairs: '11' covers 11 and 12, '13' covers 13 and 14, and so on to '65' = 65 or 66
- Column '0' is starred on the chart: used only when the firing side has 1-4 raw anti-armour points before terrain effects, or when shifts take a column below 1 (SPI 14.33: a shift below zero is treated as zero)
- Chart modifier: the phasing player reads one row lower (an 11 or 12 row is unaffected). Terrain shifts are on the Terrain Effects Chart and in SPI 14.3; restated in rules/60-combat.md
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 97) and cross-checked cell by cell against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p3); 0 of 306 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
